name: spendguard-app
description: Monitoring layer for Soroban x402 spending limits — reads public on-chain data and computes whether a spend pattern is approaching or has crossed a limit enforced by OpenZeppelin's smart account.

scripts.build: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:indexer && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --project packages/sdk/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project indexer/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm -w packages/sdk run test && npm -w indexer run test
